changes.audio: Removed creation and playback of synthesized turf footsteps. Breathing, ambience and ball impact remain.
changes.support: Final upper-body composition retains solved pelvis/knee/shoe support rather than restoring input.pose. A bounded, short ground anchor reduces side/backward shoe sliding; acceleration loads active balance without random falls.
changes.techniques: 56 generated native pass/shot/cross variants, up from 26. Ankle, torso and shoulder curves vary inside/outside/toe/knuckle techniques; original root, hip, knee, timing and native fallback clips remain.
changes.receptions: Receiving forecast includes bounded adjustment steps and braking. Real swept skin hits can cushion legal body regions, with separating relative velocity. Planned receptions and saves must meet real skin at the actual physics instant.
changes.keepers: Intentional backpasses use a stable receiving plane rather than chasing changing earliest intercepts. Trap/control commands preserve keeper approach. Save planning includes motion during preparation, side, height and arrival time. Contact markers and planning use the same anatomical arms as the live rig; a bounded gradual shoulder correction reaches the real ball surface. Speculative dives cannot cancel a pending foot interception or evacuate a central body block.
changes.restarts: The pre-whistle guard blocks the taker ball action while preserving legal off-ball movement. Rendered position checks cover both preparation and the authorized wait for release.
changes.tactics: An onside wide defender can offer an outside overlapping lane. Safe circulation becomes available after 450 ms of possession, and open long-shot selection is slightly less restrictive.
changes.preserved: Approved full-stick/RB pace, first-person camera, input semantics, original gait files, native recovery, charged passing and first-time actions.

previous_failed_checks: keeper controls an intentional backpass with an authored foot contact
superseded_test_outcomes.reason: The test incorrectly excluded a real emergency foot poke. Replacement also requires that the kick reverses a goal-bound backpass away from goal and that no own goal occurs.

investigated_findings: The old final pose assignment discarded calculated leg support. Regression checks now inspect final foot positions, not only intermediate metrics.
A global restart guard erased every actor command before authorization; it now preserves movement for non-takers while continuing to reject early strikes.
Keeper reception commands forced idle or replaced the stable intercept with a forward chase, causing overshoot on fast displaced backpasses.
Fallback saves omitted the native approach displacement and could choose a low sideways dive for a central higher arrival.
Save planning used unprojected arms, while the live pose applied anatomical limits; the predicted hand position could therefore miss real skin.
Future approach prediction omitted ten percent of the native displacement curve; live playback and prediction now share one normalized curve, with no enlarged skin tolerance.

A rapid diagnostic fixture cycle allowed a previous corner shot to leave play before the next setup. A configurable initial lab scenario provides isolated reproduction without altering gameplay; the final suite retains the complete eleven-scenario sequence.
limits: Rendered regressions use Linux/X11, a virtual Xbox controller and the OpenAL null driver. Windows GUI behavior, physical controller feel and acoustic balance still need evaluation on the user PC.
The fresh Windows cross-build is checked for PE architecture, transitive DLL closure, complete media, exact launchers and ZIP CRCs.
This is a native animation-driven/Bullet prototype with active physical responses. It does not include Euphoria, GTA code, learned motor control or new captured animations.
The profile/source compatibility count is an eligibility inventory, not exhaustive visual validation of every combination.
The approved controlled ground-dribble collision exemption remains. Tests do not establish universal absence of interpenetration or perfect goalkeepers in all matches.
